subject: Aurora Health — AWS marketplace collaboration deck & onboarding runbook request
messages:
From: Samantha Price <samantha.price@aurorahealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Allen <jordan.allen@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora evaluation — marketplace / field collaboration

Hi Priyom / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Aurora is very interested in a path to production but we need a clear joint plan for AWS enablement and the marketplace listing. Two asks up front:

- Can Redwood share a short deck (3–5 slides) that we can show to our internal procurement and security teams that outlines the marketplace model, data flow (PII considerations), and expected timelines?
- Do you have an onboarding runbook or checklist (what the customer needs to provide, required security artifacts, approximate timeline) that we can use for our technical kickoff?

I've attached a one-page requirements note that summarizes what our security team will expect. Jordan from AWS is CC'd — we'd like the AWS field team to attend an initial 30–45 minute sync to understand listing prerequisites and any incentives we should be aware of.

Proposed window: Wed 7/21 or Thu 7/22, morning PT. Let me know what works.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Price
Director, Cloud Programs
Aurora Health
(attachment: Aurora-Requirements.pdf)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Price <samantha.price@aurorahealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Allen <jordan.allen@amazon.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora evaluation — marketplace / field collaboration

Samantha — thanks for the clear ask and attaching the requirements. We can absolutely put together both artifacts and run the kickoff with the AWS field.

Quick plan: 
- I will share a customer-facing two-slide "marketplace brief" tailored to Aurora (value prop, compliance highlights, timeline) by EOD tomorrow.
- Karthik will draft a 1-page onboarding runbook that lists deliverables, security artifacts (SOC2 summary, data retention options, KMS patterns), and an expected 6–8 week timeline for private deployment + marketplace listing steps.
- Suggest a joint sync on Wed 7/21 at 10:30am PT — 30 minutes to align owners, then a follow-up technical kickoff with Aurora engineers.

Agenda for the 7/21 sync (proposed):
1) Introductions & objectives (5m)
2) Marketplace enablement checklist (10m)
3) Customer data flow & compliance questions (10m)
4) Next steps & owners (5m)

I'll drop the invite once I hear confirmation from Jordan/AWS and Samantha. Attaching our internal field notes that we use for marketplace conversations — it's short and may help frame the meeting.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(attachment: Redwood-AWS-Field-Notes.pdf)

Subject: Planning note — Aurora engagement (prep for 7/21)

Jordan / team — looping you in so we can align field enablement. A few items to confirm on the AWS side before the sync: 

- Which AWS contact should Aurora list for the marketplace application? (account owner vs partner contact)
- Any marketplace gating items that typically add >2 weeks (e.g., security review windows, payment setup)?
- Is there a co-funding / co-marketing checklist we should present to Aurora to accelerate buyer conversations?

Internal ask: Vivek, can you confirm whether we recommend a private deployment first or listing + private deployment in parallel for a healthcare customer with PHI concerns? My initial recommendation is private deployment (VPC + KMS) with a parallel marketplace listing to avoid blocking procurement.

I'll consolidate answers into a single slide to bring to the 7/21 sync.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference

Thanks — Wed 7/21 10:30am PT works for us. I've included our lead engineer on the thread in case there are technical clarifying questions during the sync.

A couple of notes in advance:
- Attached is a quick diagram of our intended data flow and where we expect Redwood to run (edge vs. private VPC).
- Procurement asked that we have a short "proof of compliance" doc up front — if you can bring a short summary of SOC2 scope and encryption controls that would be ideal.

See you on Wednesday.

Best,
